version.description: Schema version for the command-policy file (currently 1).

summary.description: Planner-owned summary metadata for the current command-policy revision. Treat this object as the strict planning gate snapshot finalized by Planner after Preflight and Spec-Checker have both run for the current story state.

loop_status.description: Planner-finalized strict readiness gate for starting the executor loop after the required Refiner → Preflight → Spec-Checker sequence for the current command-policy revision. Treat this as the single machine-readable readiness summary for the story. Refiner must initialize this field in every newly written command-policy.json, including stories with no must_exec commands; use 'needs_refinement' until Planner has consumed current preflight and spec-check results. Preflight must not overwrite this field; it refreshes only helper availability and command availability metadata.

available_helper_commands.description: List of base helper command names (for example 'rg', 'grep', 'wc') that are available for this task after preflight. Refiner must still initialize this field to [] in every newly written command-policy.json, including stories with no must_exec commands, until Preflight records available helpers. Executor may call these commands directly with appropriate flags and arguments.

last_spec_check_status.description: Most recent top-level `status` reported by Spec-Checker for the current command-policy revision. Planner should refresh this field after each current spec-check run.

last_spec_check_feasible_for_loop.description: Most recent top-level `feasible_for_loop` reported by Spec-Checker for the current command-policy revision. Planner should refresh this field after each current spec-check run.

blocking_failure_types.description: Distinct routed `failure_type` values from current blocking Spec-Checker issues for the current story revision. Treat an issue as blocking when it contributes to top-level `status: "needs_revision"` or `feasible_for_loop: false`; do not use `severity` as the blocking test. Use [] when there are no current blocking routed failures.

blocking_issue_ids.description: Spec-Checker issue IDs that currently block loop readiness for this command-policy revision. Treat an issue as blocking when it contributes to top-level `status: "needs_revision"` or `feasible_for_loop: false`; do not use `severity` as the blocking test. Use [] when there are no current blocking issues.

commands.description: List of allowed commands (or templates) for this task.

id.description: Stable command identifier in lowercase kebab-case (for example cmd-npm-test).

command.description: Concrete command line or command template. May include parameter placeholders like {{pattern}} or {{subdir}} for Executor to fill in at runtime.

role.description: High-level role of the command (for example build, test, lint, doc, explore).

usage.description: How critical this command is for the story.

availability.description: Preflight result for this command as recorded by the planner.

related_requirements.description: Requirement IDs from acceptance-index.json that this command mainly serves.

probe_command.description: Non-destructive variant of the base CLI used only for preflight probes.

parameters.description: Metadata for template parameters such as {{pattern}} or {{subdir}}.

description.description: Short explanation of the parameter semantics.

usage_notes.description: Human-readable notes about how this command should be used in the same natural language as the current user-facing conversation unless higher-priority instructions override that default. Use an empty string when there is no note.
